name: Xverse
source: https://xverseapp.notion.site/xverse-brand-public (official brand assets, Logo page: Xverse Logo – Various Formats.zip, Symbol/Dark/xverse_icon_blackcolor 1.svg)
notes: Default: the kit's standalone symbol for light backgrounds (Symbol/Dark/xverse_icon_blackcolor 1.svg: the #0F0F0F X body and the #EE7A30 accent), paths unchanged and placed on the 64 grid. It replaces the white X on a #181818 disc, a container no official asset uses (the kit's symbols have no background; the xverse.app webclip.png app icon is a dark rounded square)

Mono: the same two paths in currentColor; the body and the accent are already separated by the kit's own gap, so no seam is added (the kit's white symbol, xverse_icon_whitecolor.svg, has the same geometry)
